review: The greeting must mean morning, not afternoon or evening.

source: Good morning. This is a short test.
reference: सुप्रभात। यह एक छोटा परीक्षण है।
review: Preserve both the greeting and the statement about a short test.

source: I do not want to cancel the order.
reference: मैं ऑर्डर रद्द नहीं करना चाहता।
review: The speaker wants to KEEP the order; do not reverse the negation.

source: The meeting is at 9:30 tomorrow morning.
review: Preserve tomorrow, morning and 9:30; equivalent numeral scripts are acceptable.

source: The price is 1,250 rupees, not 250 rupees.
review: Preserve both amounts, currency and which amount is rejected.

source: Could you speak more slowly, please?
reference: क्या आप कृपया थोड़ा धीरे बोल सकते हैं?
review: Keep the polite request/question, rather than inventing a statement.

source: ReFlow Studio keeps the original background music.
reference: ReFlow Studio मूल पृष्ठभूमि संगीत को बनाए रखता है।
review: Keep the product identity and that background music is preserved, not removed.

source: Some call me nature. Others call me Mother Nature.
reference: कुछ लोग मुझे प्रकृति कहते हैं। दूसरे मुझे धरती माँ कहते हैं।
review: Preserve the two groups and personification; do not treat either sentence as unrelated dialogue.
